host_clock: monotonic ns, relative to No.3 command send completion
instantaneous: first actual valid host observation at/after nominal, strictly after issue and inside No.3
E: new sequence and same epoch as input INA
P: each ID independently, target_seq=one-based raw file data-row ID (no firmware sequence)
A_RAW_clock: host receipt of representative sample; exact physical sample timestamp unavailable
A_STAT_window: [t+h,t+h+w) host-receipt membership; closes at host deadline t+h+w
A_STAT_validity: all samples finite, no detected sequence gaps, one epoch, whole window within No.3
A_STAT_sequence: last included sequence for matching; first/last and native FIFO read_end_ms stored separately
vibration_persistence_window: (t-w,t] using same size/statistics and validity rule as target
unavailable: NaN target value and -1 clock/id, per-output target mask is isfinite(y)
duplicate_h: both paired horizons flagged when same issue and target response/sample ID and time
duplicate_prior_issue: subsequent issue at same horizon marked if prior issue matched same sample ID and time
